Welcome to Comoros – The Perfume Islands of Africa!
In this vlog, we explore Grande Comore, the main island of Comoros, on a scooter and experience a side of Africa that very few tourists get to see.
Comoros is blessed with turquoise waters, volcanic landscapes, lush green mountains and beautiful Indian Ocean beaches. But once you leave the capital and travel through the villages, you also see the challenges of everyday life — limited infrastructure, unfinished roads, basic facilities and very little tourism development.
